status: Seven generated cameo stills for owner review. No pixel editing, animation or runtime integration.

images.name: peek-hello
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve.
Asset: one square 1024 x 1024 still for a small Travi cameo in the Travary app.
Identity reference: image-1-travi.png. Copy THIS character's identity, colours, paper materials and permanent luggage tag, but do NOT copy the portrait canvas, small full-body framing or folio.
Travi is a coral ribbed-spinner suitcase, with navy trim and corner caps, gold telescopic handle with a navy grip, navy top carry handle, black spinner wheels with gold hubs where visible, cream luggage tag with a navy palm tree hanging from his handle, big friendly cartoon eyes and navy brows, and articulated folded-paper hands. Tactile folded-paper craft look and warm soft light as in the identity reference.
Background: plain evenly lit chroma green about #00B140 with nothing else in it. Slight texture and small colour variation are fine. No visible floor, horizon, cast shadow, gradient, scenery or green spill. Crisp contours, no motion blur.
Any held boarding pass or card is completely blank, without text, numbers, logos, lines or symbols. Keep the navy palm tree on his permanent luggage tag as explicitly required. No added text, labels, UI, logos or watermark. No navy holiday folio anywhere.
Make ONE image for the specified pose.

PEEK FORMAT: square 1024 x 1024. Travi peeks up from behind an invisible wall represented by the image's BOTTOM EDGE. Do NOT draw a wall, ledge, shelf, rail, postcard or table: these are supplied by the app. The actual canvas bottom crops directly through his coral suitcase body a little BELOW his MOUTH. We see his extended handle, face, permanent palm tag and paper hands; his lower body and ALL wheels are below the image and must NOT be visible. This is a large upper-body close-up, not a small full-body figure floating in green.
Centre his body horizontally, approximately 560 pixels wide. The TOP of his telescopic navy handle grip is about 140 pixels below the TOP of the image. Place his expressive face low enough that the bottom canvas edge cuts the body just below his mouth. His body visibly continues beyond the bottom edge. Hands resting on the edge touch and curl across the bottom canvas boundary, partly cropped there.
Keep this same peek camera, body scale and body placement in all six peek poses; only arms, expression and the specified props change. Small pixel differences are fine.

POSE 1 — PEEK HELLO:
Peeking up happily, BOTH folded-paper hands resting directly on the bottom canvas edge as if leaning on the top of an invisible wall. Bright friendly eyes on the viewer, warm CLOSED-MOUTH smile. Hands empty. No wall is visible.
images.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT TARGET: peek-hello.png, the generated square cameo. image-1-travi.png is the supporting identity reference only.

Make ONE targeted correction to the peek-hello composition: the actual BOTTOM CANVAS EDGE must cut through Travi's coral body, just below his face. Remove the green band currently visible beneath his torso and hands. EXTEND his coral ribbed torso downward, beyond the bottom of the canvas, so the bottom of the image crops him naturally. Lower his resting paper hands to the true bottom edge and crop their fingertips slightly there. There must be NO visible horizontal cut-off edge of the torso floating above the canvas bottom. Green remains at the sides only; between his hands and under his face, coral body reaches the actual bottom edge.

Keep the current friendly closed-mouth smile, eyes, navy/gold telescopic handle, cream hanging palm luggage tag, warm folded-paper materials and centred character position. No wheels, lower-body corner caps, folio, wall, table, shelf, rail or drawn ledge. Plain even chroma green close to #00B140, small texture acceptable. No text or UI. Output square 1024 x 1024.
